result.instructions: Tools for SalesPlay POS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products are running low on stock in our main shop?"; "List the receipts from yesterday and their payment types."; "Add a new customer named Ada Lovelace with her e-mail address.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SalesPlay POS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run salesplay_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run salesplay_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run salesplay_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. salesplay_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: salesplay_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer record. Only first_name is required. Creates a new record each call. SalesPlay API: POST /customers.

tools.name: salesplay_create_product
tools.title: Create a product
tools.description: Create a product with its cost and its price in each listed shop. Stock tracking and flags default to off. Creates a new product each call. SalesPlay API: POST /products.

cost.description: Cost price as text, for example "4.50" (required).

price.description: Sale price in this shop, as text (for example "9.90").

shops.description: Shops that sell the product, each with its price (required).

stock_control.description: Track stock for this product (default false).

tools.name: salesplay_update_inventory
tools.title: Set inventory levels
tools.description: Set the stock quantity of products in shops. Each item sets the absolute in_stock value, so repeating the call gives the same result. SalesPlay API: POST /inventory.

in_stock.description: Units in stock after the update.
